{{Top|leg}}
The '''''shar'tas''''', or placard, was a piece of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that protected the wearer's stomach and innards. It sit below the two ''[[Hal'cabur|hal'cabure]]'' as part of the ''[[haalas]]'', or cuirass.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
